description: Convert a PayPal activity export (German or English CSV) into a DATEV EXTF v700 Buchungsstapel. Every transaction is booked on the PayPal account against a clearing account, every PayPal fee as its own booking against Nebenkosten des Geldverkehrs. Pending, denied and memo rows are left out and counted. Returns the bookings as JSON, the EXTF file as base64 (Windows-1252) and a reconciliation of gross, fee, net and balance. Up to 500 transactions per call. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/paypal-to-datev.

clientNo.description: DATEV Mandantennummer for the file header (optional)

consultantNo.description: DATEV Beraternummer for the file header (optional)

counterAccount.description: Counter account of the gross bookings (default Geldtransit 1360 / 1460)

csv.description: The PayPal activity export as CSV text (empty = built-in sample export)

dateOrder.description: How to read dates like 03/04/2026: auto, day first or month first

feeAccount.description: Account of the PayPal fees (default 4970 SKR03 / 6855 SKR04)

fileContent.description: Or the CSV file base64-encoded (UTF-8 or Windows-1252, max 10 MB)

paypalAccount.description: Account of the PayPal balance (default 1361 SKR03 / 1461 SKR04)

name: paypal_to_datev
title: PayPal CSV to DATEV API - EXTF Buchungsstapel (SKR03 / SKR04) with fee bookings
